cards.title: Define the intended customer experience in a customer strategy
cards.claim: The speaker presents customer strategy as an organization-wide umbrella that specifies what customers should feel across their journey and translates customer principles into practice.
cards.action: Define the customer experience you want to deliver and create a strategy that explains and actions how to make it happen.
applies_when: The desired customer experience has not been defined.
People across the organization need clarity on their role in delivering the journey.
do_not_use_when: There is no evidence in this passage that a particular strategy format or framework will fit every organization.
unknowns: How to define the experience in practice.
How to assign ownership or measure strategy execution.
evidence_quotes: "what you have decided that the experience should be what you want your customers to feel in the whole journey they have with you"
"then you need to put a strategy there that shows and explains and actions to make it really happen"
"a customer strategy it's like this umbrella over the whole organization"
"what are the customers principles we live by and what does that translate to into practice"

cards.title: Use customer journey mapping to view the experience from the customer perspective
cards.claim: The speaker describes customer journey mapping as a tool for understanding, designing, and managing the customer experience, including identifying where focus matters most to customers and business results.
cards.action: Map the customer journey to create a realistic view of the experience and identify where to focus.
applies_when: You need to assess whether current processes can deliver the intended service or product experience.
You need to understand the journey from a customer rather than internal perspective.
do_not_use_when: The work only documents internal processes rather than customer-experienced interactions.
unknowns: How priorities should be selected or weighted.
evidence_quotes: "how capable are your business processes right now in delivering your customer journey"
"customer journey mapping is a tool to be able to answer that question"
"it's the most powerful tool to design and manage the whole experience"
"by mapping this customer journey you get an outside and understanding of the experience they have"
"mapping this will also help you to ship see where you should put your focus where it matters most to your customers and to your business results"
"customers don't experience processes they experience a journey"

cards.title: Enable people to deliver the desired experience
cards.claim: The speaker frames people, culture, and enabling processes as necessary to bring a customer-experience strategy to life.
cards.action: Ensure people know the business and customer-experience strategy, and enable them and relevant processes to deliver the desired experience.
applies_when: You have defined a desired customer experience.
You need the organization to act in customers' interests.
do_not_use_when: The desired customer experience and strategy have not been defined.
unknowns: What process changes or enablement are needed.
How to assess whether people are ambassadors of the experience.
evidence_quotes: "creating the right culture and the environment to enable people to think and act in the interests of the customer"
"do our people know the business and the customer experience strategy"
"how do you enable people or your processes and so forth to deliver this desired experience"
